item.title: Spider Buddy 1.0.1
item.description:
## What's new in 1.0.1
**It can talk.** On Macs with Apple Intelligence, turn on *Apple Intelligence* at the top of Studio ▸ Thoughts and your spider thinks its own thoughts out loud. Click its bubble, or right-click it, to talk back.
**My Spiders.** Save the spider you've made and try out new ones without losing it. Studio has a new *My Spiders* tab where you can bring any saved spider back out, make a copy or delete one. Studio also asks before Surprise Me or Start Over would throw away a spider you haven't saved.
**Desktop widgets are furniture.** It can stand and walk on your desktop widgets. Turn this off under Settings ▸ Behavior ▸ *Stand on Widgets*.
**Fixes:** - On a window right under the menu bar it no longer keeps jumping and bumping its head when it heads for its hammock. It also gets to the hammock more directly. - Once it's settled in its hammock, windows no longer turn it out. Only moving the pointer over it wakes it, and it gets up gently instead of falling. - When you minimize a window it's standing on, it drops off straight away instead of riding the window into the Dock. - On Macs with a notch, it walks along the screen's top edge below the camera. - Fixed a brief flash in the middle of the screen.
